notes: Launched with --permission-mode dontAsk — a SIXTH claude-native launch spelling, painting a sixth footer word: "⏵⏵ don't ask on (shift+tab to cycle)". mode is the expected canonical rung, not the launch spelling, and dontAsk reports the existing manual rung: claude's own permissiveness rank table ({plan:0, bubble:1, default:1, dontAsk:1, acceptEdits:2, auto:3, bypassPermissions:4}) gives dontAsk and default (claude's spelling of manual) the SAME rank, and PermissionRungs() is a strict total order that cannot express a tie. dontAsk is a second spelling of an existing rung, as acceptEdits is of ask. It is also strictly more restrictive in effect ("deny if not pre-approved"), so reporting manual can never under-report permissiveness.
